Renaissance Technologies LLC Has Lifted Verisign INC (VRSN) Position by $17.75 Million; Market Value Declined Posted by Lawrence Diaz 04 pm
Renaissance Technologies Llc increased its stake in Verisign Inc (VRSN) by 1.6% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Renaissance Technologies Llc bought 110,924 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.82% with the market. The hedge fund held 7.04M shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $1.13 billion, up from 6.93 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Renaissance Technologies Llc who had been investing in Verisign Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.87B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.04% or $2.9 during the last trading session, reaching $139.54. About 523,644 shares traded. VeriSign, Inc. (NASDAQ:VRSN) has risen 39.16% since December 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 39.16% the S&P500.
Renaissance Technologies Llc, which manages about $63.99B and $97.27B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Amdocs Ltd (NASDAQ:DOX) by 55,300 shares to 248,200 shares, valued at $16.38 million in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Leidos Hldgs Inc (NYSE:LDOS) by 1.21 million shares in the quarter, leaving it with 231,150 shares, and cut its stake in Workday Inc (NYSE:WDAY).
